# Quant Desk

> Crypto derivatives terminal with recorded order flow, cross-venue funding, open interest, liquidation clusters, RSI screener, positioning, Hyperliquid whale positions and Deribit options. Free core; Pro adds depth and automation. Data is informational only, not investment advice.

## Core pages
- [Terminal](https://quantdeskterminal.com/): live market record and terminal.
- [Platform](https://quantdeskterminal.com/platform): boards, free versus Pro.
- [Methodology](https://quantdeskterminal.com/methodology): sources, cadence and limits.
- [Coverage](https://quantdeskterminal.com/coverage): datasets, retention and known gaps.
- [API](https://quantdeskterminal.com/api): endpoint catalogue, private beta.
- [Locations](https://quantdeskterminal.com/locations): regional landing pages.
- [Blog](https://quantdeskterminal.com/blog): notes on derivatives data, plus Spanish, French and Turkish translations.
- [Learn](https://quantdeskterminal.com/learn): microstructure glossary.
- [About](https://quantdeskterminal.com/about): family-built project in Norway.
- [Contact](https://quantdeskterminal.com/contact): support, billing and API requests.

## Tools
- [Position sizer](https://quantdeskterminal.com/tools/position-size)
- [Liquidation calculator](https://quantdeskterminal.com/tools/liq-calc)
- [Funding arbitrage calculator](https://quantdeskterminal.com/tools/funding-arb)
- [DCA planner](https://quantdeskterminal.com/tools/dca)

## Data sources
Binance USD-M futures, Bybit linear, OKX SWAP, Coinbase spot, Deribit options, Hyperliquid public account state, FRED, European Central Bank, Marketaux news.

## Ownership and contact
Owned by Tanue Alain Che; a family project built with his son in Norway. Contact: support@quantdeskterminal.com.
